descriptions.w3d_h1c_border_mesh_8029358c: Updates border mesh vertices using an observed twenty-vertex local grid and original vertex-order table. Clamps border/inset to dimensions, retains four nested engine objects, locks the vertex array, forms grid and inset coordinates, sets output z to zero, clears the dirty flag, derives bounds and a bounding sphere, then releases nested objects in reverse order. Local Vec3, box and sphere extents are twelve, twenty-four and sixteen bytes; external engine class names remain inferred.
